pipeline_name: Srednevilyuyskoye Gas Condensate Field-Yakutsk Gas Pipeline

validity.recommendation: No structural fix needed. Existence, classification, and non-duplicate status are all solidly corroborated by primary/near-primary sources (regional government, national TV broadcaster, industry press, Rostekhnadzor). See the two separate flags below (attribution: a wrong-scope Capacity ref; spec: an early vs. final cost-estimate note).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real and extensively documented. This is the THIRD LINE ('третья нитка') of the Srednevilyuyskoye GCF-Yakutsk trunk system, an 84km segment from Kysyl-Syr (Vilyuysky District) to the Mastakh field area (Kobyaysky ulus). Construction began April 2022 (ysia.ru welding-ceremony report 2022-04-20; gtrksakha.ru; 1sn.ru); completed and formally granted permission for industrial operation on 2024-12-23 by Deputy PM Alexander Novak and Head of Yakutia Aisen Nikolaev via videoconference (gtrksakha.ru, dated same day); independently confirmed complete by Rostekhnadzor's compliance inspection (angi.ru, 2024-11-19: 'Третья нитка... полностью соответствует проектным требованиям... выдано заключение о соответствии объекта требованиям проектной документации'); a Jan-2023 industry trade article (nedradv.ru) independently describes the same 84km third-line project (700mm pipe, ~8.57bn RUB) mid-construction. Five independent, mutually corroborating sources spanning the whole 2022-2024 build/launch timeline -- this is not a GEM-only or single-sourced entity. CLASSIFICATION: Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are correct. dfo.gov.ru (Trutnev far-eastern-federal-district report) and gtrksakha.ru both explicitly call it a 'магистральный газопровод' (trunk/transmission gas pipeline); nedradv.ru likewise ('участка третьей нитки... магистрального газопровода'). DUPLICATE CHECK against the 32-row roster's 8-row Sakhatransneftegaz Srednevilyuyskoye-Yakutsk family (P3365, P6695, P3361, P3364, P6691, P2334, P6696, P6694): P3361 is specifically the 84km Kysyl-Syr-Mastakh THIRD line, distinct in name, length, and build era from every sibling checked this run -- it is NOT the same object as the older Mastakh-Berge-Yakutsk corridor (382km per family notes; a 2019 neftegaz.ru incident report on that OLDER, then-51-year-old pipe at km 239 is a different, much longer-established segment -- see the attribution flag below, which explains why that article is a bad Capacity ref for THIS row despite superficially overlapping names) nor the Taas-Tumus-Yakutsk lines (P2334/P6696, a wholly separate 1960s-era corridor). No relabel/segment-double-count risk found for P3361.

validity.researcher_notes: The current_ref (https://neftegaz.ru/news/incidental/194257-ushcherb-ot-vzryva-na-gazoprovode-srednevilyuyskoe-gkm-mastakh-berge-yakutsk-vozmeshchen/) is a 2019-02-27 incident report about a DIFFERENT, much older pipe: a Dec-2018 gas explosion/fire and forest-fire damage at km 239 of the 'Средневилюйское ГКМ-Мастах-Берге-Якутск' trunk, on a pipe section that the article states had been 'в эксплуатации 51 год' (in service 51 years, i.e. built c.1968 -- part of the original Soviet-era system, not P3361's 2022-built third line). validity.researcher_notes: nedradv.ru (2023-01-09, quoting a Dec-2022 print edition) states the total project cost as 'около 8,57 миллиарда рублей', matching the recorded 8,570,000,000 RUB exactly, with the 2.8bn RUB federal-budget component independently re-confirmed by yk24.ru (2024-11-19: 'на строительство этого объекта из федерального бюджета направили 2,8 млрд рублей'). An earlier ysia.ru report from the April 2022 construction-start ceremony cites a lower total estimate of 5.4bn rubles (2.8bn federal + 1.3bn republic budget + 1.3bn Sakhatransneftegaz investment program) -- this is simply an EARLIER, lower estimate at groundbreaking that later rose to the final ~8.57bn figure as the project proceeded through its three construction stages (common for multi-year infrastructure); not a conflicting source, just a project-cost history worth noting.
